reason: The cited evidence (E1) demonstrates that monolayer graphene interfaces in CoCrFeNi/graphene nanolayered composites block crack propagation and stimulate dislocations, supporting the premise that such interfaces impede dislocation motion. However, the study focuses on strength and crack resistance under compression, not on time-dependent creep or activation energies, so the specific claims about creep rate reduction and higher activation energy are extrapolations without direct experimental support.
